01 / THE PROCEDURES

TWO
PROCEDURES.
ONE GOAL.

Weight-loss surgery is a major medical decision. The right procedure depends on individual health, medical history, goals and specialist assessment. BEYOND helps make that process clear, coordinated and professionally managed from the first consultation.

01 / GASTRIC SLEEVE

Sleeve

Sleeve gastrectomy reduces the size of the stomach, helping patients feel full with smaller amounts of food. The procedure is performed laparoscopically through small abdominal incisions in a hospital setting, following individual medical assessment.

Laparoscopic procedure
Simplified medical illustration
02 / GASTRIC BYPASS

Bypass

Gastric bypass changes the route food takes through the digestive system and can support substantial weight reduction in appropriately selected patients. The procedure is commonly performed laparoscopically, using small abdominal incisions and specialized surgical instruments.

Laparoscopic procedure

04 / LIFE AFTER

MORE LIFE.
MORE FREEDOM.

Weight-loss surgery is not only about losing weight. For appropriately selected patients, meaningful weight loss can make everyday movement easier, support better physical health and create more freedom in daily life. The goal is not simply a smaller number. It is the possibility of living differently.

Everyday Movement

For many patients, changes in weight can make movement, exercise and everyday activities feel more manageable.

A Different Relationship With Life

The journey can be about more than a number on a scale — it can create space for new routines, new confidence and a different way of experiencing everyday life.
